loadMore.$description: LoadMore's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--load-more-<name>) on the page, a container or one LoadMore, and every LoadMore inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

text.$description: "Showing 20 of 134" and the end text (4.5:1 on the page).

gap.$description: Space between the summary and the button (12px).
